title: Stoneware vase in the potting nook

tokens.v: Overfilled a moment ago: water still sheeting over the rim and running the full curve of the body, the matte glaze turning dark and slick below the waterline while it stays chalk-dry above, one bead hanging at the lowest point about to fall. A galvanised watering can stands behind, its rose still dripping onto the soaked bench. 90mm at f/2.8, camera at bench height, tight on the body from just off-centre. A fern frond crosses the top-left well out of focus and is cut by the top edge; grit and dark water spots pit the bench through the near foreground.
